From /r/European:

Translation of the article on the site:

They are popping up like mushrooms, the refugee-centers of politician Dijkhoff. It's happening so fast that even the COA (Central Organ Asylumseekers) claims it no longer has any idea as to how many there really are, and they have now stopped responding to any press inquiries regarding this issue.

They just go North-Korean mode if you ask normal questions. The platform 'De Onderste Steen'* announced it will not back down and together with the umbrella organisation "AZC Alert" (Refugee Center Alert) they filed information requests to all dutch Municipalities and then compiled the results into a handy refugee center overview.

82% of the Dutch municipalities now has a refugee center and that number is growing by the day. Refuge centers at arm's length for everyone! (PDF), is what this list is showing us.

Key: Red = (Recent) refugee center; Orange = concrete plans or actively working towards adding a refugee center (both with money and/or in cooperation with other municipalities); Green = Municipalities without refugee centers.

Some of those are actively trying to arrange things, only the plans aren't concrete enough to change them to a different color than Green.

Furthermore, there is a distinction in the type of care (long-term, crisis, lasting only several days, unaccompanied minors, additional status holders, etc). This list is up to date until January 18, but in 2016 this list will only become longer.

We ask ourselves why the COA (Central Organ Asylumseekers) refuses to make this information public and to answer any questions from the press.

There shouldn't be any secrets regarding refugee centers and the amount of refugees and migrants being housed, especially when considering that the willingness of housing a refugee center is shaky at best.

Proactive transparency promotes room for discussion because citizens want to be better informed and feel less like they are being left out in the decision making process.

Here follows a quick explanation of the PDF:

From left to right..

Gemeentenaam = The name of the Municipality

noodopvang = emergency housing

crisisopvang = crisis housing? ( I really don't know the distinction between this one and the one above, my guess it the duration of how long this housing lasts.)

processopvang = processing housing

gezinslocatie = family location

vrijheids-beperkend = restrictive-privilege / restricted housing / I find this one harder to translate but its housing for those who have been denied the right to stay in the Netherlands and will be returned to their country within 12 weeks.

azc-regulier = normal refugee center.

AMV-location = Unaccompanied minors refugee location

extra-statushouders = additional status holders (don't quite follow the definition of this)

So all of the above are in regards to the type of housing of the refugees, and the numbers in the rows beneath them represents the amount of refugees in those housing facilities.

Einddatum en/of bijzonderheden = end-date and particularities

beoogd aantal = target amount of refugees

Provincienaam= province name ( we have 12 provinces in the Netherlands, containing multiple municipalities and municipalities contain multiple cities and / or villages )
